articles.title: 700,000-Year-Old Squirrel Poop Reveals a Lost Ecosystem—and a Mystery Species
articles.summary: Scientists thawed ice-age squirrel poop from the Yukon and found DNA inside. It reveals what they ate—including mammoth bones—and suggests the ancient squirrels may be a different species than today's.

articles.title: 'You Just Saved the Video Dish': Astronauts Complete Critical Spacewalk Repair
articles.summary: Two astronauts replaced a broken antenna on the ISS during a 6.5-hour spacewalk. Mission Control celebrated with a parody of 'Video Killed the Radio Star.' The repair restores a crucial communication link.

articles.title: Screen Time at Age 1 and 6 Tied to Lower Grades and Weaker Memory Later
articles.summary: A study of 502 kids found that heavy screen time at age 1 and age 6 was linked to poorer academic performance at 9 and weaker working memory at 10.5. Timing matters, not just total time.
